Components / UI

Command

The searchable picker. cmdk is DOM/keyboard-first with no mobile analogue, so on a phone the palette IS a bottom sheet with a filter and a virtualized list.

  • v0.2.1
  • ui
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/command.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/command.json
